desc: Ideation: f(x,y) = weight of LCA in Kruskal reconstruction tree; optimal assignment via bottom-up max-matching at each internal node (exchange argument); verified on both samples by hand.
Implement Kruskal with DSU building the reconstruction tree: parent/children arrays of size 2N, node weight = edge weight at merge; internal node ids N+1..2N-1 in increasing weight order.
Implement bottom-up matching: count cA/cB at leaves; iterate internal nodes in creation order; match = min(sA[c1],sB[c2]) + min(sA[c2],sB[c1]); ans += match*w; propagate surpluses.
Drop binary-lifting LCA and K² cost-matrix approaches — superseded by the O((N+M)α(N)) greedy.
Write final solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), no recursion; verified against samples and edge cases (duplicates in A/B, skipped edges in Kruskal, root matches all remaining pairs).
